BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.

2. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard

   D. Speaker

   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

11. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

13. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
